description: Search hackathons listed on 黑123 (hack123.henryht.sh). Bilingual (zh/en) fields; every result has its site URL. status: upcoming = start date in the future, open = deadline today or later, ended = deadline passed (dates in UTC, YYYY-MM-DD).

city.description: City name in Chinese or English, e.g. 上海 / Shanghai

from.description: Earliest date (YYYY-MM-DD); matches events whose start or deadline is on/after it

online.description: true = online only; false = offline/hybrid only

query.description: Keywords matched against titles, aliases, summaries, topics, cities (zh or en)

theme.description: Topic, e.g. AI / Web3 / 具身智能

to.description: Latest date (YYYY-MM-DD); matches events whose start or deadline is on/before it

name: search_hackathons
title: 搜索黑客松 / Search hackathons
